cases.name: Suzanne Renee Biddle
cases.about:
Her daughter made a statement: "Anyone who knew my mom knew what a special person she was. She had a smile that could light up an entire room and a kindness that made people feel welcome, valued, and loved. She was the type of person who always treated everyone with respect, no matter who they were or what they were going through. She never hesitated to lend a helping hand, offer words of encouragement, or simply be there when someone needed her.

One of the many things she loved most was animals. Her heart was so big, and she showed compassion not only to people but to every animal she came across. The love and care she gave so freely reflected the beautiful person she was inside and out."
